    KafkaService.browse(String topic, int maxMessages, boolean fromBeginning)
    Browses up to maxMessages from topic with no consumer-group side effects: the consumer has no group.id, uses manual assign (never subscribe) and enable.auto.commit=false, and seeks to the beginning or end of every partition.
